en: You very likely heard the term prompt by
now. The prompt is simply the input you're
sending to
a generative AI model, a large language
model, to ChatGPT, for example.
It's whatever you ask the model to do or
whichever information you send to the model.
It's worth noting though that of course your
prompt
is nowadays
often not just a sentence or two. It may
also combine a bunch of documents you're
sending to the model, a bunch of of
documents you want the model to analyze,
maybe an image, and so on. It's an important
piece of the overall context that's sent to
the model in the end. Your prompt is what
you directly control, but as mentioned in
the context lecture, the context then is
your prompt and potentially the entire past
conversation, plus a lot of instructions you
may not even see, like system instructions
or tool descriptions and so on. But your
prompt is what you control, and it's your
prompt, which you can optimize to get the
best result for a certain task.
